verdict.rationale: RingCentral ships agentic voice AI products such as the AI Receptionist, so letting users connect external MCP servers to them is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows the opposite direction: RingCentral offers its own MCP servers and connects to LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude, which is server-side and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing shows RingCentral's AI features consuming tools from user-supplied MCP servers.
